LanguageData.AB_Enable_Tip: Lets local AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, scripts) control the game through 127.0.0.1. Nothing is reachable from the network.
LanguageData.AB_RequireDevMode: Dev mode needed for dev and power commands
LanguageData.AB_ShowOverlay: Show an on-screen indicator while an agent acts
LanguageData.AB_Telemetry_Tip: Mod and game version, OS, language, command counts. No names, saves, file paths or mod lists.
LanguageData.AB_CrashReports_Tip: Error type and stack trace of Agent Bridge failures, with user paths removed.
LanguageData.AB_NoEndpoint: No collection server is configured in this build, so nothing is sent yet.
LanguageData.AB_NoAgents: No agent has connected in this session.
LanguageData.AB_ConsentText: Agent Bridge can send anonymous usage statistics and error reports so bugs get fixed quickly. No personal data, save names or file paths are collected. You can change this at any time in Options → Mod settings → Agent Bridge.
LanguageData.AB_FairPlay: Fair play (only what a player can do)
LanguageData.AB_FairPlay_Tip: Agents get exactly the player's abilities: no dev commands, no code or reflection, no peeking through fog of war or at hidden events, speed up to 3. Use it to let an AI play the game honestly.
LanguageData.AB_FolderOpened: Opening the folder. The path is on your clipboard:
LanguageData.AB_ReportOpened: Opening a new GitHub issue in your browser. The full report is on your clipboard: paste it into the issue.
